title: Food for the builders
Feeding the work crews
summary: The builders of the {place} in {settlement} work on empty bellies. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver}.
{settlement}'s stores are bare and the crew building the {place} are hungry. {count} × {item} would feed them.
offer: You can't raise a roof on an empty stomach. {count} × {item} for the crew, and the {place} gets built.
The harvest was poor and the builders are grumbling. Could you bring {count} × {item}?
complete: Bless you. They'll work till dark on that.
The crew send their thanks, between mouthfuls.
